themes_detail.label: Dead/Dying Trees Surge
themes_detail.summary: Sunset Park residents filed 8 complaints about dead or dying trees THIS WEEK, a 540% spike compared to the 1.2-complaint weekly average over the prior 8 weeks, signaling either rapid tree deterioration or newfound community concern about the district's canopy health.
evidence: 8 dead/dying tree complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.2 weekly baseline (540% increase, z-score 4.85)
Spike occurred in same week as 9 complaints about overgrown tree/branches (454% spike, z-score 5.24)
Long-standing community board budget request for 'new or expanded park or amenity' suggests prior neglect of green infrastructure
reporting_angles: Inspect specific locations where complaints clustered to assess tree health and Parks Dept. maintenance schedules
Interview Parks officials about whether disease, weather damage, or deferred maintenance is driving the spike

themes_detail.label: Smoking/Vaping Complaints Double
themes_detail.summary: Sunset Park residents filed 5 smoking or vaping complaints THIS WEEK, a 471% spike above the 0.9-complaint weekly average, marking a sudden enforcement or compliance change in an area with potential public health and quality-of-life implications.
evidence: 5 smoking/vaping complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.9 weekly baseline (471% increase, z-score 5.28)
Spike is most recent after dead trees and boiler issues but narrower in scope
No corroborating Reddit, news, or community board signals yet; may be neighborhood-specific enforcement effort
reporting_angles: Determine if NYPD or Parks enforcement launched a new initiative targeting outdoor smoking
Identify hotspot locations and interview residents about whether public smoking has worsened or if awareness has increased

themes_detail.label: Boiler Failures Spike
themes_detail.summary: Sunset Park residents filed 3 boiler complaints THIS WEEK, a 500% spike above the 0.5-complaint weekly average, occurring in the middle of winter and potentially affecting heat/hot water access for vulnerable residents as heating season intensifies.
evidence: 3 boiler complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.5 weekly baseline (500% increase, z-score 5.0)
Heat/hot water complaints remain the second-largest complaint category overall (966 in last 90 days), suggesting systemic housing stock issues
Boiler spike coincides with winter season when failures pose direct health and habitability risks, especially for elderly or low-income tenants
reporting_angles: Cross-reference this week's 3 boiler complaints with HPD violation and building age data to identify affected buildings
Interview tenants and landlords about winter maintenance failures; assess whether aging housing stock in Sunset Park lacks preventive maintenance funding

themes_detail.label: Drug Activity Explodes in One Week
themes_detail.summary: Sunset Park had 5 drug activity complaints LAST WEEK, a staggering 1900% spike above the 0.2-complaint weekly average over 8 weeks, representing the most severe statistical anomaly in the dataset and warranting urgent investigation into whether a new market, supply route, or enforcement gap has emerged.
evidence: 5 drug activity complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.2 weekly baseline (1900% increase, z-score 10.97, highest in dataset)
Spike is one week old, not from this week, but severity and z-score make it the single most anomalous signal
Overlaps with other public order complaints: 6 drinking complaints 2 weeks ago (269% spike), 3 unleashed dog complaints 3 weeks ago (2300% spike)—suggests broader disorder or enforcement pattern
reporting_angles: Map the 5 drug complaints to specific blocks or parks; contact NYPD for 77th Precinct intelligence on new trafficking activity or supply disruptions
Interview community leaders and advocates about whether street conditions have visibly deteriorated and whether residents feel safe

themes_detail.label: Public Disorder Cluster
themes_detail.summary: Sunset Park has experienced overlapping spikes in drug activity (5 complaints last week), drinking (6 complaints 2 weeks ago), and unleashed dogs (3 complaints 3 weeks ago), suggesting either a localized disorder zone or a pattern of deteriorating public space management across multiple enforcement domains.
evidence: Drug activity: 5 complaints last week (1900% spike, z-score 10.97)
Drinking: 6 complaints 2 weeks ago (269% spike, z-score 5.11)
Unleashed dogs: 3 complaints 3 weeks ago (2300% spike, z-score 8.69)—all high-severity anomalies occurring in same 3-week window
Community board has requested street outreach expansion for 1+ year, suggesting prior awareness of homelessness/substance use issues
reporting_angles: Geo-map all three complaint types to identify whether they cluster in specific parks (e.g., Sunset Park itself, Fourth Avenue corridor) or are district-wide
Interview Parks, NYPD, and DHS officials about whether a single encampment, open-air market, or enforcement gap underlies the convergence
Canvas affected neighborhoods for resident safety concerns and document quality-of-life impact
